label: SIMULATED fly brain (FlyWire 783) vs chip readouts

B1_disinhibition_releases_feeding_from_b.test: Spearman(block fraction, MN9|sugar+bitter) over vehicle + 5 gaba_block levels >= 0.8

B2_excitation_block_silences_motor_outpu.test: Spearman(block fraction, readout) <= -0.8 for both readouts over vehicle + 4 ach_block levels

C2_chip_is_the_earlier_sentinel.test: for each condition family with any impairment: first level with |delta log2 mfr| >= 0.5 comes at or before the first level with disruption >= 0.5

A1_direction_agreement_with_real_chips.test: sum of fly agreeing features >= sum of twin agreeing features, scored on the same established real features

D1_spontaneous_direction_is_near_chance.test: whole-region sign agreement on strongly asymmetric pairs < 0.65

D2_pulsed_stimulation_recovers_direction.test: whole-region sign agreement on strongly asymmetric pairs >= 0.70 and exceeds the spontaneous value by >= 0.10

D3_an_electrode_array_sees_it_too.test: array sign agreement on strongly asymmetric pairs >= 0.65
